root_causes_repaired: malformed receipt JSON roots could escape typed validation through AttributeError
acceptance traces were not bound exactly to frozen acceptance IDs and cryptographically verified canonical evidence
repair-contract semantics did not distinguish normative requirements from adversarial falsifier or repair-scope proposals, permitting a causally impossible receipt-preexistence interpretation

finding_adjudication.reason: A population must be frozen before reviewer execution, while a receipt is generated by that execution. Therefore receipt bytes cannot preexist the population freeze. The enforceable invariant is frozen receipt path and expected identity before execution, followed by exactly one immutable receipt origin strictly after the freeze.
Acceptance trace criteria now bind exactly to the frozen contract; canonical evidence references require source classification and SHA-256 verification.
Non-object receipt JSON now returns a typed RECEIPT_MEMBER_<i>_OBJECT_REQUIRED validation error.

regression_tests_added: immutable post-freeze receipt is accepted as causally valid
malformed receipt root returns a typed validation error
substituted acceptance criterion IDs are rejected
acceptance trace requires cryptographic evidence bindings
